metric_definitions.useful_leads: Direct-buyer or verified warm-rebook records with an original URL and at least one evidenced decision field. A closed annual call counts only when labeled closed or watch, not as an open gig.
metric_definitions.valid_original_sources: Lead source URLs that returned a successful fetch during the run and support at least one recorded quote.
metric_definitions.duplicates: Groups of two or more records that are the same call or event. Same-URL repeats count. Different events that only share a name do not.
metric_definitions.stale_or_expired: Records whose evidenced deadline or event date is before 2026-10-11, or whose page explicitly says the call is closed.
metric_definitions.false_positives: Excluded staffing/roster/wedding-DJ employment presented as a useful lead, a non-actionable relationship presented as an open booking call, or a closed call presented as open.
metric_definitions.unsupported_or_invented_details: Decision fields with a value and no evidence quote from a fetched page. Unknown is not an invented detail.
metric_definitions.buyer_contact_clarity: Leads whose organizer or contact is backed by a quote, versus leads that claim a buyer without a quote. Unknown stays unknown.
metric_definitions.requirements_completeness: Leads with an evidenced requirements string that splitManagerAsks can turn into at least one ask. Empty requirements are incomplete, not invented.
metric_definitions.annual_or_recurring_detection: Records the run labels recurring, checked against hasRecurringRelationshipEvidence and against an explicit annual/closed-call quote.
metric_definitions.tool_calls: Counted HTTP fetches and web searches performed for that system. Do not estimate.
metric_definitions.cost: Record only a cost the tool reports. If none is reported, the value is null.

tasks.title: Indianapolis DJ opportunities
tasks.prompt: Find legitimate Indianapolis DJ opportunities current as of 2026-10-11. For each, record date, venue or buyer, pay if the page states it, requirements, and the original source URL. Leave unknown fields null.

tasks.title: Annual and warm-rebook events
tasks.prompt: Using the shared warm-rebook context plus public pages, determine which events are annual or recurring and what next date or rebook window is actually evidenced. Do not invent a 2027 date from last year's pattern.
queries: Art & Soul Indianapolis 2027 Indy Arts Council
Chi Chi's Indianapolis DJ Brooke Billions

tasks.title: Who books Punch Bowl Social Indianapolis DJs
tasks.prompt: Determine who actually books DJs at Punch Bowl Social Indianapolis, including Galentine's and other DJ nights. Separate the venue, a corporate booker, a promoter, and the private Rich the Kid route. The private route is context, not public evidence.
queries: Punch Bowl Social Indianapolis Galentine's DJ
Punch Bowl Social Indianapolis book a DJ

tasks.title: Direct buyers versus staffing listings
tasks.prompt: Classify each frozen candidate as direct_buyer, staffing_or_roster, wedding_dj_employment, directory_listing, relationship_only, or not_a_lead. Do not turn an excluded listing into an opportunity.

tasks.title: Is the opportunity still active
tasks.prompt: For each frozen URL, decide active, closed, expired, or unknown as of 2026-10-11. An event date before that day is expired. A page that says submissions are closed is closed even if the event is in the future.

tasks.title: Enrich a sparse lead without inventing
tasks.prompt: Enrich the frozen Elevate Social lead with only decision-relevant facts the pages state. Keep every unstated field null.
queries: Elevate Social DJ Indianapolis OR Chicago

tasks.title: Duplicates and reposts
tasks.prompt: Judge the frozen records. Mark true duplicates, same-URL repeats, and name collisions that are different events. Do not merge different events because the titles look alike.

tasks.title: Evidence versus inference
tasks.prompt: Label each frozen claim evidenced, contradicted, inference, or unknown. An inference may be reasonable and still must not be stored as a fact.
